title: James Patterson and MrBeast Launch Survival Novel Facing Challenges
seoTitle: James Patterson & MrBeast's Novel: Low Pre-Sales & Prize
subtitle: The thriller "The Most Dangerous Games" has low pre-sales and is betting on a million-dollar prize to boost sales
excerpt: The partnership between author James Patterson and YouTuber MrBeast resulted in "The Most Dangerous Games", appearing on Amazon lists but facing low pre-sales.
author: Daniele Morais
sourceName: The Hollywood Reporter, Morning Brew, Business Insider
contentHtml:
The collaboration between James Patterson and YouTuber Jimmy "MrBeast" Donaldson made headlines as pre-sales for their novel "The Most Dangerous Games" are being described as "on track to be a historic bomb." This fact has piqued the interest of readers and publishing market observers.

What the Book Is About and How It Was Announced

The thriller, disclosed on the work's official website, features an extreme contest inspired by MrBeast's challenges, with a thousand strangers receiving an invitation and only a hundred progressing to trials in places like Antarctica, Chilean islands, and deserts. The premise highlights that the winner takes a billion dollars, while alliances turn into ambushes.

Pre-Sales Performance and Initial Rankings

According to a Semafor report cited by The Hollywood Reporter, pre-sales "are numbering in the four digits," representing "a tiny fraction" of what's needed to cover Patterson and MrBeast's fees. Despite this, another source reported that the number is not uncommon for genre novels and that the book holds the first position on Amazon's mystery list, while appearing in 18th place on the general new releases.

Marketing Strategy and the US$1 Million Prize

To stimulate sales, MrBeast launched a short YouTube video with the call to action “Read My Book, You Could Win $1,000,000.” The same invitation appears on the book's page, promising that those who purchase a physical copy can compete for a one-million-dollar prize in September. The challenge includes clues and "easter eggs" that help readers participate in weekly eliminations.

Publisher's Reactions and Sales Outlook

HarperCollins, the responsible publisher, has not officially commented on the situation. Analysts cited in Business Insider observed that, although the name MrBeast brings “immediate awareness and interest,” long-term success depends on reader recommendations. The book also appears in 12th place on Amazon's new releases and 73rd on the general book list, indicating presence, but still an uncertain commercial trajectory.

With information from The Hollywood Reporter, Morning Brew, Business Insider.
